annotations.text:
Option A - Confident Minimal
Black/white, red used only twice (headline word + hairline). Thin borders, no shadows. Quiet-luxury consulting-firm register.
Trade-off: safest but least distinctive.

Option B - Bold Technical
Dark navy base, red used energetically, geometric grid + diagonal light, heavy display type. Reads as a company that builds hard technical systems.
Trade-off: highest visual energy, but a bigger departure from the current site.

Option C - Warm Enterprise
Warm off-white base, soft shadows, rounded cards, friendly modern-SaaS register (Stripe/Attio-adjacent).
Trade-off: most approachable, but softer/less "enterprise-serious" than A or B.
Main - currently holds Option A as the leading candidate. Pick a direction above and I'll build the final version here.
